entities.summary: Shoma Chaudhury (b. 1964-06-11, Darjeeling) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Darjeeling and India. Known in the fields of india, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
